EZCORP offers pawn loans to consumers seeking short-term cash and sells pre-owned merchandise to retail shoppers. T:P1.4.text: Encore Capital Group® is a global specialty finance company with operations and investments across North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America. Through its subsidiaries around the globe, Encore purchases or services portfolios of receivables from major banks, credit unions and utility providers. Customer service and regulatory compliance are at the heart of our business and are implemented through our collections strategy.

T:P2.3.text: Across all our businesses, we seek to treat each and every consumer fairly. By listening to and understanding each individual situation, we are able to offer our consumers affordable and sustainable payment solutions, individualized to meet their needs. In the U.S., we codified our consumer commitment by creating the industry’s first Consumer Bill of Rights. T:P2.9.text: Through our subsidiaries and affiliates, we purchase portfolios of defaulted receivables from financial service providers including banks, credit unions, consumer finance companies, and commercial retailers. After purchasing defaulted debt, we partner with individuals as they repay their obligations and work toward financial recovery. We also provide debt servicing for consumer and business-to-business accounts as well as portfolio management services to credit originators for non-performing loans.

T:P2.10.text: Our long-term success and continued growth comes as a result of our competitive advantage in five key areas:

T:P2.11.text: We leverage an industry-leading consumer database, in-house statisticians, business analysts, and software programmers to continually enhance proprietary behavioral and valuation models, custom software applications, and other business tools that guide our portfolio purchases and collection strategies.

T:P2.12.text: We focus on raising and deploying capital prudently to maximize our return on invested capital. Our operational scale and geographic diversification enable us to adjust to market trends and deploy capital to maximize risk-adjusted returns.

C:P3.2.text: EZCORP provides customers the opportunity to convert merchandise they no longer need into instant cash. We buy quality used items ranging from gold and diamond jewelry to electronics, video games, musical instruments, tools, sporting goods, and more. We pride ourselves on fair and accurate appraisals. Quite simply, we help our customers get more money for their things.

C:P3.3.text: In today’s economy, a growing number of consumers demand value, and EZCORP delivers. We sell an array of quality used items at budget-friendly prices. Our selection of merchandise is wide and ever-changing and includes gold, jewelry, electronics, tools, sporting goods, luxury handbags, shoes & sneakers, musical equipment and much more!
